title.zh: DCX/CX初态与光子快离子修正

summary: Build the collisional-radiative initial state for one DCX/halo marker: select the thermal species, add the fast-ion density only on the exact-isotope branch, weight the caller's level-resolved CX rates, and derive the photon fast-ion correction.

identity.relation: source_density = thermal_density[selected] + (fast_ion_density if beam_mass_amu == thermal_mass_amu[selected] else 0); initial_states = cx_rates * source_density (elementwise); photon_fast_ion_correction = thermal_density/source_density on the exact-isotope branch with positive source density, else 1, clamped at 0; eligible = sum(initial_states) > 0.
identity.direction: level-resolved CX rates + aligned thermal density/mass vectors + selected species index + fast-ion density + beam mass -> initial-state density vector, photon correction, source density, isotope flag, eligibility flag
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM DCXCX初态与光子快离子修正 operator (framework node N3): the initial-state weighting consumed by colrad for DCX and halo markers. Rates, densities and masses are caller-owned; the operator does not generate rates, trajectories or photons. A zero-sum initial state is ineligible, not an error.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with a registered finite-output gate
identity.geometry: one marker in one local cell; level axis ordered by the caller's six-level state convention
identity.coordinates: densities in cm^-3, masses in amu, rates in s^-1; the initial states carry the source's cm^-3 s^-1 weighting convention
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative rates and densities; positive masses; a strict in-range integer species index (bools and fractions rejected); nonnegative finite fast-ion density; positive finite beam mass; all outputs finite (registered)
assumptions: The caller supplies level-resolved CX rates already reduced at the marker position and velocity.
The exact-isotope comparison is strict float equality on masses, per the source.

inputs.name: thermal_ion_density_cm3
inputs.description: Thermal-ion densities aligned with the mass vector.

inputs.name: thermal_mass_amu
inputs.description: Thermal-ion masses aligned with the density vector.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; same shape as the density vector.

inputs.name: selected_thermal_species_index
inputs.constraints: A genuine in-range integer in [0, n_thermal); bools, fractions and whole-number floats (e.g. 0.0) rejected (registered).

inputs.name: fast_ion_density_cm3
inputs.description: Local fast-ion density, counted only on the exact-isotope branch.

inputs.name: beam_mass_amu
inputs.description: Beam-ion mass for the exact-isotope comparison.

outputs.name: photon_fast_ion_correction
outputs.description: Photon fast-ion correction factor (thermal share on the isotope branch, else 1).

outputs.name: source_density_cm3
outputs.description: Selected source density (thermal plus fast-ion on the isotope branch).

outputs.name: same_isotope
outputs.description: Whether the beam mass strictly equals the selected thermal mass.

outputs.name: eligible
outputs.description: Whether the initial state sums to a positive density.
outputs.constraints: False for an all-zero state; consumers must not fabricate propagation.

preconditions: Caller-owned level-resolved CX rates and an aligned thermal plasma snapshot.
supported: Per-marker DCX/halo colrad initial-state weighting with the source isotope correction.
excluded: CX-rate reduction, track geometry, colrad time advancement, photon storage and Monte-Carlo loops.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any vector is misshaped or contains non-finite/negative/non-positive values where required, when the species index is not a strict in-range integer, or when the fast-ion density or beam mass violates its bound.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the initial-state products, source density or correction overflow to non-finite for finite but extreme input magnitudes (registered hardening); the saved arm returns Inf states with eligible=True silently.

python.signature: prepare_dcx_colrad_initial_state(*, cx_rate_per_s, thermal_ion_density_cm3, thermal_mass_amu, selected_thermal_species_index, fast_ion_density_cm3, beam_mass_amu)

example.description: The saved package's isotope probes: same-isotope weighting with the thermal-share correction, and the different-species pass-through.
example.code:
from scirel.fusion import prepare_dcx_colrad_initial_state
matched = prepare_dcx_colrad_initial_state(
    cx_rate_per_s=[1.0, 2.0], thermal_ion_density_cm3=[3.0, 5.0], thermal_mass_amu=[1.0, 2.0],
    selected_thermal_species_index=1, fast_ion_density_cm3=7.0, beam_mass_amu=2.0)
assert matched['same_isotope'] and abs(matched['photon_fast_ion_correction'] - 5.0/12.0) < 1e-15
assert list(matched['initial_states']) == [12.0, 24.0]
try:
    prepare_dcx_colrad_initial_state(
        cx_rate_per_s=[1.0e308], thermal_ion_density_cm3=[1.0e308], thermal_mass_amu=[2.0],
        selected_thermal_species_index=0, fast_ion_density_cm3=0.0, beam_mass_amu=2.0)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('an overflowing initial state must fail closed (registered hardening)')
example.expected: The isotope probes reproduce; the overflowing product raises ValueError.
